summary: In the November 2026 Visa Bulletin, EB-3 Final Action Dates advanced for 4 of 5 chargeability areas and held steady for 1 (Philippines). The biggest move was All other countries and Mexico, up 31 days (≈1.0 months) to Jun 15, 2024.
EB-3 Other Workers Final Action Dates advanced for 3 of 5 areas. All other countries and Mexico jumped 151 days (≈5.0 months) to Jun 1, 2022.

EB-3 Dates for Filing (Table B) did not change. For EB-3 Other Workers, Table B advanced 30 days (≈1.0 months) to Jul 1, 2022 for All other countries and Mexico. USCIS says employment-based applicants must use Table B to file Form I-485 this month.

sections.heading: EB-3 Skilled Workers and Professionals advanced for four of five areas in November 2026
paragraphs: In the November 2026 Visa Bulletin, EB-3 Final Action Dates (Table A) for All other countries and Mexico both advanced 31 days (≈1.0 months), from May 15, 2024 to Jun 15, 2024. India advanced 21 days (≈0.7 months), from Jan 1, 2014 to Jan 22, 2014. China (mainland-born) advanced 14 days (≈0.5 months), from Jan 8, 2022 to Jan 22, 2022. The Philippines did not change and stays at Aug 15, 2023.

EB-3 Dates for Filing (Table B) did not change for any area. They are Aug 1, 2024 for All other countries and Mexico, Apr 1, 2024 for China (mainland-born), Jan 1, 2024 for the Philippines, and Jan 15, 2015 for India.

The gap between the two charts varies a lot by country. Table B is 800 days (≈26.3 months) ahead of Table A for China (mainland-born), 358 days (≈11.8 months) ahead for India, 139 days (≈4.6 months) ahead for the Philippines, and 47 days (≈1.5 months) ahead for All other countries and Mexico. For November 2026, USCIS says employment-based applicants must use Table B to file Form I-485.

sections.heading: EB-3 Other Workers jumped 151 days for All other countries and Mexico
paragraphs: In the November 2026 Visa Bulletin, EB-3 Other Workers Final Action Dates for All other countries and Mexico advanced 151 days (≈5.0 months), from Jan 1, 2022 to Jun 1, 2022. This is the largest move in either EB-3 category this month. India advanced 21 days (≈0.7 months) to Jan 22, 2014, the same date as India's EB-3 Skilled Workers and Professionals Final Action Date. China (mainland-born) stays at Oct 1, 2019, and the Philippines stays at Jan 1, 2022.

EB-3 Other Workers Dates for Filing (Table B) advanced 30 days (≈1.0 months) for All other countries and Mexico, from Jun 1, 2022 to Jul 1, 2022. Table B did not change for China (mainland-born) at Oct 1, 2020, India at Jan 15, 2015, or the Philippines at Jun 1, 2022.

Table B is now 366 days (≈12.0 months) ahead of Table A for China (mainland-born), 358 days (≈11.8 months) ahead for India, 151 days (≈5.0 months) ahead for the Philippines, and 30 days (≈1.0 months) ahead for All other countries and Mexico.

sections.heading: EB-3 Skilled Workers and Professionals 6- and 12-month record
paragraphs: Over the last 12 bulletins (since November 2025), the EB-3 Final Action Date for All other countries and Mexico moved from Apr 1, 2023 to Jun 15, 2024, a net gain of 441 days (≈14.5 months). It advanced in 8 bulletins, stayed the same in 3, and retrogressed in 1. Over the last 6 bulletins (since May 2026), the net gain is only 14 days (≈0.5 months), from Jun 1, 2024 to Jun 15, 2024: 3 advances, 2 unchanged, and 1 retrogression.

China (mainland-born) moved from Mar 1, 2021 to Jan 22, 2022 over 12 bulletins, a net gain of 327 days (≈10.7 months), with no retrogressions. Over the last 6 bulletins it gained 221 days (≈7.3 months), advancing in 5 of 6.

India moved from Aug 22, 2013 to Jan 22, 2014 over 12 bulletins, a net gain of 153 days (≈5.0 months), and gained 68 days (≈2.2 months) over the last 6. The Philippines gained 136 days (≈4.5 months) over 12 bulletins, from Apr 1, 2023 to Aug 15, 2023, but only 14 days (≈0.5 months) over the last 6, with 5 of those 6 bulletins unchanged. Neither India nor the Philippines retrogressed in the last 12 bulletins.

sections.heading: EB-3 Other Workers 6- and 12-month record
paragraphs: Over the last 12 bulletins (since November 2025), the EB-3 Other Workers Final Action Date for All other countries and Mexico moved from Jul 15, 2021 to Jun 1, 2022, a net gain of 321 days (≈10.5 months). It advanced in 7 bulletins, stayed the same in 4, and retrogressed in 1. Over the last 6 bulletins (since May 2026), it gained 120 days (≈3.9 months), from Feb 1, 2022 to Jun 1, 2022.

China (mainland-born) posted the largest 12-month gain in EB-3 Other Workers: from Dec 1, 2017 to Oct 1, 2019, a net gain of 669 days (≈22.0 months), with 6 advances, 6 unchanged, and no retrogressions. Over the last 6 bulletins it gained 242 days (≈8.0 months).

India's EB-3 Other Workers record matches its EB-3 Skilled Workers and Professionals record: a gain of 153 days (≈5.0 months) over 12 bulletins and 68 days (≈2.2 months) over 6. The Philippines moved from Jul 15, 2021 to Jan 1, 2022 over 12 bulletins, a net gain of 170 days (≈5.6 months), and gained 61 days (≈2.0 months) over the last 6. None of these three areas retrogressed in the last 12 bulletins.

faq.q: Can I file my EB-3 I-485 in November 2026?
faq.a: Possibly. For November 2026, USCIS says employment-based applicants must use the Dates for Filing chart (Table B). If your priority date is earlier than the Table B date for your category and country, you may be able to file, but other eligibility requirements still apply. The EB-3 Table B dates are Aug 1, 2024 for All other countries and Mexico, Apr 1, 2024 for China (mainland-born), Jan 1, 2024 for the Philippines, and Jan 15, 2015 for India.

faq.q: How much did EB-3 India move in the November 2026 Visa Bulletin?
faq.a: The EB-3 India Final Action Date advanced 21 days (≈0.7 months), from Jan 1, 2014 to Jan 22, 2014. The same move applies to EB-3 Other Workers. India's Dates for Filing did not change and stay at Jan 15, 2015 in both categories. That is 358 days (≈11.8 months) ahead of the Final Action Date.

faq.q: Did EB-3 Philippines move in November 2026?
faq.a: No. The EB-3 Philippines Final Action Date stays at Aug 15, 2023, and the EB-3 Other Workers Philippines Final Action Date stays at Jan 1, 2022. The Dates for Filing also did not change: Jan 1, 2024 for EB-3 and Jun 1, 2022 for EB-3 Other Workers.

faq.q: What is the difference between a Final Action Date and a Date for Filing?
faq.a: A Final Action Date (Table A) shows which priority dates can have a green card approved. A Date for Filing (Table B) is usually later and shows which applicants may submit their paperwork early. Each month USCIS says which chart to use for Form I-485, the adjustment of status application. For November 2026, employment-based applicants must use Table B.
